$comment: Spec 036 Phase F (Cluster A10) golden-set v1 fixture. Consolidates the agency-disambiguation, authority-precedence, COMDISPLAN-activation, and tie-break entries used by F-A1+A3 + F-A6 contract tests. Each entry has shape: {id, scenario, query, jurisdiction, expected_agency?, expected_agency_role?, expected_authority_level?, expected_precedence_rank?, comment}. The full body lands in T220; this file is the seed.
